verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs explicitly claim a unified place to 'manage your local models, prompts, and configurations' alongside model search/download, and community feedback confirms model management (download/search via HF) is easy and well-liked. However, no independent evidence details prompt management specifically, and community reports cite UI rough edges, unclear model discoverability, and missing features, suggesting the experience is functional but not fully polished as an all-in-one hub.
